change: Candidate validation requires a lowercase SHA-256 fitted response matrix hash in every report.
evidence: econ-package.test.mjs rejects missing, null, empty and malformed hashes even with a matching report review; changing a valid matrix hash invalidates the existing review and changes the immutable package identity after re-review.
compatibility: Reports from older fitters without matrixSHA256 must be re-exported and refitted before packaging.
limits: The candidate validator checks hash presence and binds it through the report hash. It does not independently inspect response bytes; calibrate.R performs that byte comparison before fitting. No operational model was approved or activated.
